title: Add docstrings to public API functions
objective: Add numpy-style docstrings to all public API functions: compile(), build_context(), ProblemIR, ElementIR, emit(), newton_solve().
scope: Add docstrings to compile(), build_context(), ProblemIR, ElementIR, emit(), newton_solve(), localise(), localise_and_optimize()
implementation_steps: Add numpy-style docstrings with params, returns, raises
deliverables: Docstrings on all public API functions
acceptance_criteria: Every public API function has parameter descriptions, return type, and exceptions documented

cases: compile() has a complete numpy-style public API docstring
build_context() has a complete numpy-style public API docstring
ProblemIR and ElementIR public types have clear API docstrings
emit() has a complete numpy-style public API docstring
newton_solve() has a complete numpy-style public API docstring

risks: Docstrings can accidentally promise unsupported behavior if they are written without matching the current MVP constraints.
Cross-file documentation consistency is easy to lose because this task spans multiple public API entry points.
completion_notes: Public API docstrings now use numpy-style sections and document MVP constraints plus propagated error behavior for compile(), emit(), and newton_solve().
